diagnosis: DeviceTokenRevokeView allows authenticated users to revoke active session tokens using the 8-character token_prefix. However, the query AuthToken.objects.filter(token_key=token_prefix) fails to filter by request.user. Any authenticated user who observes or predicts another user's public token prefix can invalidate active login sessions and disconnect devices belonging to other accounts.
